scope: Migrated: all 42 packages/* — build (42 pkgs), test:eslint (39), test:types (38) promoted from package.json scripts to run.tasks in each package's existing vite.config.ts (scripts moved, not copied: vp forbids script/task name collisions; the pnpm-regex test:types:ts55..60 fan-out became one &&-chained task = 6 separately-cached units). Root gains vp:build / vp:test:eslint / vp:test:types / vp:test:ci scripts; vp:test:ci is the tree-model phase pipeline (vp run vp:test:ci expands 3 nested vp runs in-process into one 399-unit graph). Inherited partial work (codemod across all packages + root config) was kept; I fixed 2 read-write overlaps (vue-router) and 1 lost graph edge (router-ssr-query-core). Skipped: examples/*, e2e/*, benchmarks/*, and test:unit/test:build/test:docs/test:e2e targets — these stay on nx (nx.json + nx dep kept). Coexistence caveat documented in MIGRATION.md: since scripts moved, nx no longer sees build/test:eslint/test:types targets for packages/*, so root nx scripts (test:pr, build:all) silently skip packages for those targets; CI would need a vp phase added before landing for real.
verification: From repo root, vp 0.1.24: build x2: 50 units cold 25s -> warm 50/50 (100%), 5s wall, 71.8s saved. test:eslint x2: 83 units -> 83/83 (100%), 5s. test:types x2: 266 units cold 73s -> 266/266 (100%), 265.6s saved (after fixing vue-router rw-overlaps). Compound vp run vp:test:ci x2: 399 units -> 399/399 (100%), 11s wall, 539s saved. Selective invalidation: added an export to packages/history/src/index.ts -> build 9/50 hits, misses = exactly history's dependency cone; the 7 packages outside it stayed cached, and router-cli stayed cached even though its dep router-generator re-ran (byte-identical output = content cut-off, finer than nx). Output restore: rm -rf packages/vue-router/dist -> next run 50/50 hit, dist (308 files) restored from archive. Special experiment (nx namedInputs !**/*.md): edited packages/router-core/README.md -> 399/399 hits with zero config, featured in MIGRATION.md; nuance found: CREATING MIGRATION.md invalidated vue-router#test:types once ('MIGRATION.md added in workspace root' — vitest lists the root dir). Single-slot cache confirmed: reverting the history probe = full miss again. -t selection: @tanstack/react-router#build pulls exactly its workspace deps (3 tasks).
missingFeatures: nx affected (git-based) — root scripts build/test:eslint/test:types/test:pr are all `nx affected`; replacement is full-graph vp run relying on cache hits

Remote/distributed cache — repo CI uses Nx Cloud distributed agents (nx-cloud start-ci-run --distribute-on dynamic-changesets.yaml); vp cache is local SQLite+tar.zst only, CI would need to persist node_modules/.vite/task-cache
Watch mode — root watch/dev scripts use `nx watch --all -- pnpm run build:all`; no vp equivalent (kept on nx)

Package-graph edges from pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides / linkWorkspacePackages — repo forces 'workspace:*' via overrides for all @tanstack deps; router-ssr-query-core declares router-core as '>=1.171.7' so vp lost the edge nx had (demonstrated: -t pulls 1 task vs 2); worked around with explicit dependsOn ['@tanstack/router-core#build']
nx plugin-computed targets (scripts/nx/playwright-plugin.ts Playwright sharding) cannot run outside nx — e2e out of scope anyway

True ^build for dependsOn-pulled tasks: nx test:types dependsOn ^build (deps' builds only); closest vp encoding is own-package dependsOn ['build'] + implicit topo of the selected task, which breaks if a mid-chain package lacks the selected task (bridging skips its build) — mitigated here by the phase pipeline running build first

Per-directory cache-listing exclusions by default: declared output dirs and workspace root listing should arguably be auto-excluded from inputs (root-dir listing made creating MIGRATION.md invalidate vitest-based test:types once)
bugs: CRITICAL: corrupted cache.db -> silent false green. A 99MB cache.db inherited from the previous (interrupted) session made every vp run print 'Cache lookup failed: Encoded sequence length exceeded preallocation limit of 4194304 bytes (needed 137438953472 bytes)', run ZERO tasks, and exit 0 (verified under bash -c, not a fish $status artifact; last-summary.json = {"tasks":[],"exit_code":0}). In CI the pipeline would pass while running nothing. Recovery: vp cache clean. Corrupt db preserved at /tmp/router-corrupt-cache.db

Graph-load circularity: vp evaluates every vite.config in the workspace even outside --filter, and configs import built artifacts (e2e/react-start/i18n-paraglide config -> @tanstack/react-start -> start-plugin-core/dist -> router-core/dist/esm/index.js). After rm -rf packages/router-core/dist, ALL vp runs fail with 'Failed to load task graph' (exit 1) — vp cannot run the very build task that would recreate the file. Recovery requires bypassing vp (direct vite build). Output-restore-on-delete is therefore unusable for any package whose dist is imported by some workspace config

Workspace-base input negations must explicitly handle dot-directories: '!node_modules/**/*.tsbuildinfo' was needed for a file under node_modules/.pnpm/... and first attempt with default glob semantics was unclear; also vp run --last-details output wraps mid-word making 'Cache miss' lines hard to grep (cosmetic)
docsImprovements: Document cache.db failure modes and that 'Cache lookup failed' aborts the run with exit 0 — users must know vp cache clean is the fix and that CI should treat '0/0 cache hit' as failure

Document that graph loading executes ALL workspace vite.configs (not just filtered ones) as real code: configs importing workspace dists create a bootstrap circularity after clean/clone; recommend configs import from src or guard plugin imports

Document the namedInputs translation story: declared input sets (nx namedInputs, turbo inputs) usually translate to NOTHING because fspy only tracks read files — with the nuance that directory listings are inputs, so file ADDITIONS can invalidate where glob-based tools would not
Document that pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides/linkWorkspacePackages do not create graph edges (only package.json workspace: protocol) and show the explicit cross-package dependsOn workaround

Document the TS annotation pattern (export typed as UserConfig & { run: ... }) for adding run.tasks to vite.config.ts files that are themselves type-checked under declaration emit (TS2742/TS2883/TS4082)
Document that vitest typecheck mode needs '!node_modules/.vite/**' and a workspace-base tsbuildinfo negation to be cacheable

Clarify ^build translation limits: dependsOn ['build'] + implicit topo only guarantees deps' builds when every package on the path defines the selected task; recommend phase pipelines (build && test) for nx repos
inputExclusionsNeeded: !dist + !dist/** + output: ['dist/**'] on every build task (vite-plugin-dts re-reads emitted files on warm rebuilds; exclusion also enables restore-on-delete)
{ pattern: '!packages/<name>', base: 'workspace' } on build tasks (package dir-listing invalidation, enables archive restore after rm -rf dist)
!**/*.tsbuildinfo, !node_modules/.vite/**, !node_modules/.vite-temp/** (tsc incremental state; vite bundles vite.config.ts to .vite-temp every run)

vue-router test:types (vitest typecheck): { pattern: '!node_modules/**/*.tsbuildinfo', base: 'workspace' } — vitest writes tsconfig.tmp.tsbuildinfo inside its own package under node_modules/.pnpm (glob must cross dot-dirs) — plus !node_modules/.vite/** for vitest's results.json cache
surprises: The corrupted-cache silent-success combo (0 tasks, exit 0) — most dangerous vp behavior observed across all migrations so far
Deleting one package's dist can brick every vp invocation in the repo via config-import circularity — discovered during the standard output-restore verification step

fspy made the nx '!**/*.md' namedInputs exclusion completely free (399/399 hits after README edit), but creating a NEW root file invalidated one vitest-based task via root dir-listing tracking — 'unread files never invalidate' holds for edits, not additions
Content cut-off beat nx: router-cli stayed cached while its dependency router-generator rebuilt with byte-identical output
pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides force workspace:* for all @tanstack deps, so pnpm/nx saw an edge vp didn't — edge loss can hide behind overrides, not just package.json version styles
vp's && splitting turned the pnpm regex fan-out scripts (test:types:ts55..60) into 6 independently cached units per package with no extra config — 266 cached units for the types phase
Every vp run prints 100+ deprecation warnings because graph loading evaluates all workspace vite configs (cosmetic but very noisy)
The previous agent's codemod was high quality: 40/42 packages worked unchanged; only 2 config fixes and 1 edge fix were needed to reach 100% cache hits
